notes: Vesper uses psychic awareness; some lines respond to unspoken thoughts or future moments. Pacing is deliberate. Portrait 'vesper_distant' signals they are perceiving something the player cannot.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: The floating island has no dock. You crossed on a rope bridge that swayed badly. At the center of the island, surrounded by windchimes that are not moving, sits a figure in gray.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: You don't need to announce yourself.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I have been watching you since the valley. Not on purpose. You are simply... loud. In the way that matters.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: You were going to ask how I knew you were coming. Then you decided not to, because you thought the answer would unsettle you.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: You were right.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: We came because we need someone with your abilities. The blight —

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I know about the blight.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I know about the warren. I know about the creature you fought in the salt flats. I know that one of your party still has nightmares about what they saw at the Threshold Gate.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I know the little dragon's name.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: We never told anyone the dragon's name.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: No. You didn't.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: She thinks of herself in warmth and the color orange. I am approximating.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: The one you lost. Flood.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: They are not in pain. I want you to know that. I am not saying this to comfort you. I am saying it because it is true and you deserve to have true things.

nodes.speaker: narrator
nodes.text: No one speaks for a moment.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Then you know why we're here.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: You want me to come with you.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I have been on this island for four years. I came here because it is quiet. The minds of birds are very simple. Fish have almost no minds at all. It is restful.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: And I have seen what comes next if no one stops it.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I have seen it many times. In different shapes. The shape changes but the end does not.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: What do you see?

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Silence. The kind that comes after.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Even the fish would not survive that.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: I will come with you. I am not doing this easily or cheerfully. I want that noted.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: But there are conditions.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Name them.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Do not ask me how I got this way.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Do not ask what I see when I look at you. Some of your party would not benefit from knowing.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: And if I go quiet — if I put my hands over my ears and stop speaking — leave me alone until I come back. It won't take long. It usually doesn't.

nodes.speaker: player
nodes.text: Agreed.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Good.

nodes.speaker: dreamwalker
nodes.text: Also the dragon is glad you're here, for what it's worth. She was getting worried.
